The '''''Barrage''-class gunship''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] manufactured by [[Alto Systems]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

The ''Barrage''-class had a fragile frame for a ship of its class, but was heavily armed, with two forward-mounted [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launchers]] and four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|launchers]], with two each mounted on the port and starboard sides of the vessel. The ''Barrage'' had the reputation of being costly to maintain and rearm, but was well-regarded by its owners. Some [[tactician]]s would carefully place ''Barrage''-class gunships to take out key enemy vessels in battle.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
